what:
KEDGE v34 flight check with the bridle (dart-physics, 9 Nov 2026). Planar rigid-body flight (pitch plane with gravity, yaw plane
without), the strip aero model of flight_sim.py unchanged (viscous cross-flow Cdc 1.2 x eta 0.65 on the top-view width for pitch /
side-view height for yaw, slender-body term rho U S'(x) where the section grows, axial CdA 2.6e-3), applied to the folded out34
geometry (dart_model profiles; dart_model now reads parts.json "joint" / "sgn"). Mass, CG and inertia from mass34.py
(out34/mass_props.json; with / without putty, bought masses +-10 %).
conventions: aoa / sideslip = angle of the velocity from the body axis, + when the nose is below (pitch) the flight path; body_pitch_at_impact = nose direction below (-) the horizon; path_deg_down = flight path below the horizon at impact; nose_first = |aoa| (or |sideslip|) under 45 deg for the whole flight (flight_sim.py's test)
